name: 666RadioCoreDJ
purpose: Discord control bot for SonicPanel/MyIDJ AutoDJ skip, Jingle/ID control and Discord voice stream with 5 presets, pause/resume/stop and volume default control.
notes: No real DJ login data is stored in public project files.
SonicPanel skip/jingle URLs must be captured from the DJ Panel network tab or supplied by the provider.
SHOUTcast kicksrc is only a fallback, not a clean AutoDJ skip.
Voice volume changes affect only the Discord bot output, not SonicPanel.
